The '''Survey-class crawler''' was a type of [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].

==Characteristics==
The crawler was a miniature version of the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] [[digger crawler]] used by the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were deployed and produced by manufacturer [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]].
